plotEn:
Babies is a 2026 American comedy-drama film written and directed by Lauren Miller Rogen. The film stars Anna Kendrick, Seth Rogen, Kate Berlant, Issa Rae, Dan Stevens, Ed Helms, Zach Cherry, Ashley Park, Sharon Stone, and David Strathairn.
The film premiered at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival on September 12, 2026, and will be theatrically released in the United States on February 19, 2027, by Roadside Attractions and Vertical.
